name: Get Company
description: Get a single company from HubSpot by its id, with a default set of company properties. Add **Additional properties to retrieve** (internal names; use **Get Properties** for `companies`) to include more. Example: Object ID `123`, Additional properties `["industry", "numberofemployees"]`. Returns the company record. [See the documentation](https://developers.hubspot.com/docs/api/crm/companies#endpoint?spec=GET-/crm/v3/objects/companies/{companyId})
